_comment: Copy to ~/.flywheel/test-slots.json and fill in values
_setup: Create bots at discord.com/developers/applications, channels in Discord server
_role: slot.role selects FLYWHEEL_LEAD_ROLE (cos vs lead — picks the base rule file: cos-lead-rules.md vs department-lead-rules.md). Required.
_identitySource: FLY-153: slot.identitySource selects which GeoForge3D .lead/<dir>/identity.md to source. Allowlist: cos-lead | product-lead | ops-lead. Optional — pre-FLY-153 configs without this field fall back to role mapping (cos→cos-lead, lead→product-lead). MUST be set for slot 3 to load Oliver instead of Peter (mirror cascade coverage requires it).
_forumChannel: FLY-115 v1.24.2 Gap C: forumChannelId is OPTIONAL. Create a Forum-type channel in the test guild per slot and grant the bot VIEW_CHANNEL, SEND_MESSAGES, SEND_MESSAGES_IN_THREADS, CREATE_PUBLIC_THREADS, MANAGE_THREADS. Omitting / empty string → test-deploy.sh logs a WARN and Bridge starts without forum support (ProjectConfig.forumChannel is absent rather than empty — packages/teamlead/src/ProjectConfig.ts:100-110).
_mirrorChannel: FLY-153: top-level mirrorChannel block is OPTIONAL. Required only for `test-deploy.sh --mode mirror`. Create one shared text channel in the test guild and invite bots flywheel-test-1/2/3 (View Channel + Send Messages + Read Message History). See packages/qa-framework/README.md §Mirror Mode for step-by-step.
